_comment: Shaped like the GitHub REST API `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls` response so the
scanner can be exercised end to end with no network access.
The `_comment` key is ignored by the scanner; the `pulls` array is the payload.
The three cases the detector must distinguish:
- #101 / #102 — same title, same base branch  => DUPLICATE (one group)
- #103 / #104 — same title, different base    => not a duplicate
- #105 / #106 — different titles, same base   => not a duplicate
All identities are obviously fake (example/repo), per the privacy-first policy.
